notes: `amp.mcpServers` is one flat key, not a nested path. Schema (ampcode.com/cli-settings.schema.json): stdio {command (required), args, env}; HTTP {url (required), headers, transport: http|sse|http-first, oauth}; additionalProperties false, so no type, enabled or disabled (V). The user file may also be settings.jsonc; derm writes settings.json only (I). Workspace servers need `amp mcp approve`. XDG behaviour NF.
